def canonical_dependency(support, rows, selection_pin):
    need(EXTERNAL_CANONICAL_RECEIPT_ABI_QUALIFIED is True,
        'external original-publication/reconciliation26/peer authority ABIs await admitted I5 ports and reviewed I2 Source successor; no JSON/CLI bypass')
    need(type(support) is dict and set(support) == DEPENDENCY_KEYS
        and support['role'] in rows, 'closed9 actual canonical Source dependency/proper4 plus separate recon review/adoption')
    role = support['role']; row = rows[role]; pin = exact_fact3(support['canonical'])
    need(pin['path'] == row['canonical_path'] and pin['bytes'] <= row['source_cap'], 'exact selected canonical dependency within original cap')
    raw = read_pin(pin,cap=row['source_cap'])
    read_pin(row['predecessor'],cap=row['source_cap'])
    need(pin['sha256'] != row['predecessor']['sha256'], 'genuine new Source bytes; no historical peer or predecessor borrowing')
    pin_original = pin
    caller = _I12_HELD_CALLER_MODULE
    if type(caller) is not types.ModuleType:
        raise I2ReceiptCallerError('E_GENERATION_SESSION_REQUIRED')
    for pin, field, body_field in ((_I12_HELD_CALLER_SOURCE, '__source_pin__', '__source_bytes__'),
                                    (_I12_HELD_CALLER_API, '__api_pin__', '__api_bytes__')):
        body = getattr(caller, body_field, None)
        if (getattr(caller, field, None) != pin or type(body) is not bytes or
                len(body) != pin['bytes'] or hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest() != pin['sha256']):
            raise I2ReceiptCallerError('E_BINDING_SOURCE_PIN')
    dispatch = caller.__dict__.get('_I2_canonical_dependency_dispatch')
    if (caller.__name__ != _I12_HELD_CALLER_NAME or caller.__file__ != _I12_HELD_CALLER_SOURCE['path'] or
            type(dispatch) is not types.FunctionType or dispatch.__name__ != '_I2_canonical_dependency_dispatch' or
            dispatch.__globals__ is not caller.__dict__ or dispatch.__code__.co_filename != caller.__file__):
        raise I2ReceiptCallerError('E_BINDING_SOURCE_PIN')
    answer = caller._I2_canonical_dependency_dispatch(support=support, rows=rows, selection_pin=selection_pin)
    if (type(answer) is not tuple or len(answer) != 2 or type(answer[0]) is not dict or
            type(answer[1]) is not bytes or answer[0] != pin_original or answer[1] != raw):
        raise I2ReceiptCallerError('E_LAYER_CONTEXT_JOIN')
    return pin_original, raw
